model: WRS-K air handling unit controller - BACnet-Pro interface
applies_to: WOLF air handling units with the WRS-K controller fitted with the newer BACnet-Pro interface (EDE index 05).
summary: The BACnet-Pro interface is WOLF's newer BACnet connection for the WRS-K air-handling controller. Unlike the older BACnet interface it publishes measurements as Analog Inputs, BMS setpoints and offsets as commandable Analog Outputs, states and alarms as Binary Inputs, stages as Multistate Inputs, the operating mode as a Multistate Value, plus trend logs, schedules for the BMS setpoints and notification classes.
notes: Taken from WOLF's EDE export for the BACnet-Pro interface (index 05, 08.07.2025); the EDE has no separate descriptions, so the descriptions here are expanded from the object names.
Access follows the EDE 'settable' column; settable outputs (AO, MO) are listed as commandable.
This is a different object set from the older WOLF WRS-K BACnet interface (BV/AV based); only a few names match.
Which objects carry real values depends on the unit's options (heat recovery type, humidifier, adiabatic cooling, fire dampers, heat pump).
Trend logs, schedules and notification classes from the EDE are included.

integration.summary: Set MV 1006 Operation_Mode and write the BMS setpoints (AO 15 temperature, AO 16 / 17 fan speeds, MO 222 fan step). Read BI 5 Status_AHU, the supply and room temperatures and BI 1 Alarm_General plus the individual alarm BIs; reset alarms with BV 1.

minimum_points.name: Setpoint_Fan_Step_BMS
minimum_points.why: Fan stage from BMS: 1 off, 2 on, 3-4 stages

integration.enable: MV 1006 Operation_Mode selects manual mode, the 7-day program or BMS mode. The EDE does not say which BMS setpoints take effect in which mode; check on site.
integration.remote_sensors: Outdoor and room temperature can be written from the BMS (AO 37 Temperature_Outdoor_BMS, AO 71 Temperature_Room_BMS, -50 to 60 °C); BI 128 / BI 134 flag problems with them.
setup: BACnet IP via the interface's network port.
gotchas: Offset objects (AO 18-22, AO 1019-1023) shift setpoints rather than replace them; check which ones the unit uses.
BI 300 Alarm_Watchdog_KLM is a watchdog alarm flag; the EDE gives no timeout.
